issue.title: @import css bug
issue.body:
Given this main.less stylesheet:

```
@import "reset.less"
@import "base.css"
```

and a directory structure that looks like this:

```
project
---styles
------main.less
------reset.less
------base.css
```

When I use LESS in Node everything is fine - main.less can import base.css. But when I use less.js in the browser, it can't find it because it's no longer looking relative to the main.less file, but relative to the index.html where less.js is used.

Line 102 of parser.js - On finish uses the error from the current import, should use the saved 'that.error' from all imports.

```
if (that.queue.length === 0) { finish(that.error) }       // Call `finish` if we're done importing
```

Can create a pull request.

issue.title: passing Parser import errors
issue.body:
parser.imports stored any errors in .error, but only returned an error to the callback on that last import in the queue.

This commit makes it return the stored error (that.error).
